blocks.zh: 第四章：前處理選項
blocks.en: Chapter 4: Pretreatment Options

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 說明 Pretreatment（前處理）在製藥水系統中的定位，理解其與 Final Treatment（最終處理）的關係。
blocks.en: Explain the role of pretreatment in pharmaceutical water systems and its relationship to final treatment.

blocks.zh: 掌握 Feedwater（進水）品質測試與文件記錄的要求，以及季節性變異的監控策略。
blocks.en: Understand the requirements for feedwater quality testing and documentation, and the strategy for monitoring seasonal variation.

blocks.zh: 區分四大類雜質控制策略：Fouling（結垢）、Scaling（水垢）、Organics（有機物）、Microbial Growth（微生物生長）。
blocks.en: Distinguish the four categories of impurity control: fouling, scaling, organics, and microbial growth.

blocks.zh: 理解 Microbial Control Agent（微生物控制劑）的添加與移除時機，特別是 Chlorine（氯）與 Chloramine（氯胺）的差異。
blocks.en: Understand when microbial control agents are added and removed, especially the differences between chlorine and chloramine.

blocks.zh: 說明 pH 在前處理中的重要性，以及 Carbon Dioxide / Ammonia 的移除策略。
blocks.en: Explain the importance of pH in pretreatment and the strategies for removing carbon dioxide and ammonia.

blocks.zh: 掌握前處理系統的 Materials of Construction（建造材質）選擇原則與成本優化考量。
blocks.en: Understand the principles for selecting materials of construction for pretreatment systems and the related cost-optimization considerations.

blocks.zh: 前處理概論  |  p45
blocks.en: Introduction to Pretreatment  |  p45

blocks.zh: 中文解析 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Pretreatment（前處理）的定位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Role of Pretreatment

blocks.zh: Pretreatment（前處理）是指在最終處理步驟「之前」的所有製程步驟。其目的是將進水（Feedwater）品質調整到足以餵入最終處理設備的水準。
blocks.en: Pretreatment refers to all process steps that come "before" the final treatment step. Its purpose is to bring feedwater quality up to the level that the final treatment equipment can accept.

blocks.zh: 最終處理步驟可能是：
blocks.en: The final treatment step may be:

blocks.zh: Reverse Osmosis, RO（逆滲透）
blocks.en: Reverse Osmosis (RO)

blocks.zh: Ultrafiltration, UF（超濾）
blocks.en: Ultrafiltration (UF)

blocks.zh: Deionization, DI（去離子）— 多床或混床式
blocks.en: Deionization (DI) - multiple-bed or mixed-bed

blocks.zh: Distillation（蒸餾）
blocks.en: Distillation

blocks.zh: 前處理做得好，最終處理設備才能穩定運作；前處理做不好，最終處理就會頻繁故障、維護成本飆高。
blocks.en: When pretreatment is done well, the final treatment equipment runs stably; when it is done poorly, the final treatment fails frequently and maintenance costs soar.

blocks.zh: 日常比喻：前處理就像料理前的食材備料
blocks.en: Everyday analogy: pretreatment is like preparing ingredients before cooking

blocks.zh: 做菜前要洗菜、去皮、切塊——這就是「前處理」。如果食材沒洗乾淨（水中雜質未去除），不管後面的烹調技術多好（最終處理設備多先進），成品都會出問題。前處理是決定水系統長期穩定性的關鍵環節。
blocks.en: Before cooking you wash, peel, and cut the ingredients - that is "pretreatment". If the ingredients are not properly cleaned (impurities in the water not removed), the dish will go wrong no matter how good the cooking technique is (no matter how advanced the final treatment equipment is). Pretreatment is the key step that determines the long-term stability of the water system.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：RO 的雙重角色
blocks.en: Key point: the dual role of RO

blocks.zh: Reverse Osmosis（逆滲透）很特殊——它既可以是前處理步驟（例如在蒸餾前先用 RO 去除大部分離子），也可以是最終處理步驟（直接產出 Purified Water）。這種雙重角色在系統設計時需要特別注意其定位。
blocks.en: Reverse osmosis is special - it can be a pretreatment step (for example, using RO to remove most of the ions before distillation) or a final treatment step (directly producing Purified Water). This dual role requires careful attention to RO's position in the system design.

blocks.zh: 前處理製程設計  |  pp. 45–47
blocks.en: Pretreatment Process Design  |  pp. 45-47

blocks.zh: 核心概念：前處理製程設計的六大考量
blocks.en: Core Concept: Six Considerations in Pretreatment Process Design

blocks.zh: 前處理的設計不是隨便挑幾個設備串起來，而是一個系統性的工程決策過程。六大考量依序為：
blocks.en: Pretreatment design is not a matter of picking a few pieces of equipment and stringing them together; it is a systematic engineering decision process. The six considerations, in order, are:

blocks.zh: 最終產水的量與質 — 終點決定起點
blocks.en: Quantity and quality of the final product water - the end point determines the starting point

blocks.zh: 溫度限制與微生物控制策略 — 冷系統 vs 熱系統
blocks.en: Temperature limitations and microbial control strategy - cold system vs hot system

blocks.zh: 最終處理方式 — RO、蒸餾、DI 各有不同的進水要求
blocks.en: Final treatment method - RO, distillation, and DI each have different feedwater requirements

blocks.zh: 進水品質 — 需要經過一年驗證週期，掌握季節性變化
blocks.en: Feedwater quality - requires a one-year validation cycle to capture seasonal changes

blocks.zh: Material Balance（物料平衡） — 進水品質與目標品質的差異，決定要移除哪些雜質
blocks.en: Material balance - the difference between feedwater quality and target quality determines which impurities must be removed

blocks.zh: 綜合考量 — 人力能力、經濟性、廢水處理、空間、公用設施等
blocks.en: Overall considerations - staff capability, economics, wastewater treatment, space, utilities, and so on

blocks.zh: 重點提示：微生物控制劑的地區差異
blocks.en: Key point: regional differences in microbial control agents

blocks.zh: 美國：市政水通常含 Chlorine（氯）或 Chloramine（氯胺）
blocks.en: United States: municipal water usually contains chlorine or chloramine

blocks.zh: 歐洲：較常使用 Ozone（臭氧）
blocks.en: Europe: ozone is used more commonly

blocks.zh: 這個差異直接影響前處理系統的設計——氯與氯胺的去除方法不同，對下游設備（特別是 RO 膜）的影響也不同。
blocks.en: This difference directly affects pretreatment system design - chlorine and chloramine are removed by different methods and affect downstream equipment (especially RO membranes) differently.

blocks.zh: 日常比喻：微生物控制劑的角色
blocks.en: Everyday analogy: the role of the microbial control agent

blocks.zh: 微生物控制劑就像游泳池裡的消毒氯——它能抑制細菌生長，保護前段設備不被微生物污染。但游泳池的水不能直接喝，同樣地，含氯的水不能直接進入最終處理設備。所以在某個時間點，必須把「消毒劑」移除，之後靠定期消毒來維持潔淨。
blocks.en: A microbial control agent is like the chlorine in a swimming pool - it suppresses bacterial growth and protects upstream equipment from microbial contamination. But pool water is not drinkable, and in the same way chlorinated water cannot go directly into the final treatment equipment. So at some point the "disinfectant" must be removed, and after that cleanliness is maintained through periodic sanitization.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「前處理可以加藥，最終產水不行」
blocks.en: Core Concept: "Chemicals may be added in pretreatment, but not in the final product water"

blocks.zh: USP 規定製藥用水（Purified Water 或 WFI）不得含有「外加物質」。但這不代表前處理過程中不能添加化學品——關鍵在於，所有添加的物質必須在前處理或最終處理中被完全移除。
blocks.en: The USP requires that pharmaceutical waters (Purified Water or WFI) contain no "added substances". This does not mean chemicals cannot be added during pretreatment - the key is that every added substance must be completely removed in pretreatment or final treatment.

blocks.zh: 常見的前處理添加物質及其移除路徑：
blocks.en: Common pretreatment additives and their removal routes:

blocks.zh: Chlorine（氯）→ 活性碳吸附或亞硫酸鈉還原
blocks.en: Chlorine → activated carbon adsorption or reduction with sodium bisulfite

blocks.zh: Sodium（鈉）→ 離子交換移除
blocks.en: Sodium → removed by ion exchange

blocks.zh: Acid（酸）→ 脫氣後由離子交換移除殘餘離子
blocks.en: Acid → residual ions removed by ion exchange after degasification

blocks.zh: Sequestrants（螯合劑）→ RO 膜攔截
blocks.en: Sequestrants → rejected by the RO membrane

blocks.zh: 重點提示：添加物質的風險
blocks.en: Key point: the risks of additives

blocks.zh: 前處理中的添加物質若導致微生物生長增加或 Endotoxin（內毒素）升高，就會成為問題。例如，亞硫酸鈉（Sodium Bisulfite）用來去除氯，但它同時移除了水中的微生物控制能力，可能導致管路內微生物快速繁殖。
blocks.en: Additives in pretreatment become a problem if they increase microbial growth or raise endotoxin levels. For example, sodium bisulfite is used to remove chlorine, but it also removes the water's microbial control capability, which can lead to rapid microbial proliferation in the piping.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：前處理投資的「槓桿效應」
blocks.en: Key point: the "leverage effect" of pretreatment investment

blocks.zh: ISPE 在這裡傳達了一個非常重要的經營概念：在前處理多投資一元，可以在最終處理省下數倍的維護費用。
blocks.en: ISPE conveys an important business concept here: every extra dollar invested in pretreatment can save several times as much in maintenance costs in final treatment.

blocks.zh: 前處理失敗（如 Hardness Breakthrough 硬度穿透）不會立即影響產水品質，但會縮短 RO 膜壽命或加速蒸餾器結垢
blocks.en: A pretreatment failure (such as hardness breakthrough) does not immediately affect product water quality, but it shortens RO membrane life or accelerates scaling of the still

blocks.zh: 前處理設計必須能應對進水品質的尖峰波動（Impurity Spikes）和季節性變化
blocks.en: Pretreatment design must be able to cope with peak fluctuations (impurity spikes) and seasonal changes in feedwater quality

blocks.zh: 沒有唯一正確答案——每個前處理設計都是一系列選擇的組合，各有優缺點
blocks.en: There is no single correct answer - every pretreatment design is a combination of choices, each with advantages and disadvantages

blocks.zh: 實務應用：前處理設計的經濟思維
blocks.en: Practical application: economic thinking in pretreatment design

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，多條產品線共用同一套水系統。前處理若設計不夠 Robust（穩健），任何一次 Breakthrough 都可能導致：
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, multiple product lines share the same water system. If the pretreatment is not designed to be robust enough, any single breakthrough can lead to:

blocks.zh: RO 膜提前更換（每支膜成本數千美元）
blocks.en: Early replacement of RO membranes (each membrane costs several thousand US dollars)

blocks.zh: 蒸餾器結垢停機（影響所有下游生產線）
blocks.en: Still shutdown due to scaling (affecting all downstream production lines)

blocks.zh: 微生物超標導致批次放行延遲
blocks.en: Microbial excursions that delay batch release

blocks.zh: 因此，前處理系統的投資回報率（ROI）往往遠高於最終處理設備的升級。
blocks.en: The return on investment (ROI) of the pretreatment system is therefore often far higher than that of upgrading the final treatment equipment.

blocks.zh: 進水品質：測試與文件  |  pp. 47–48
blocks.en: Feedwater Quality: Testing and Documentation  |  pp. 47-48

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Chloramine 的趨勢轉變
blocks.en: Key point: the shift toward chloramine

blocks.zh: 美國市政水處理正從 Chlorine（氯）逐漸轉向 Chloramine（氯胺）。這對製藥水系統有重大影響，因為氯胺：
blocks.en: Municipal water treatment in the United States is gradually shifting from chlorine to chloramine. This has a major impact on pharmaceutical water systems, because chloramine:

blocks.zh: 在活性碳上的吸附速率遠低於氯，需要更長接觸時間
blocks.en: Is adsorbed on activated carbon much more slowly than chlorine and needs a longer contact time

blocks.zh: 分解後產生 Ammonia（氨），氨會穿透 RO 和蒸餾系統
blocks.en: Decomposes to produce ammonia, which can pass through RO and distillation systems

blocks.zh: 需要不同的碳床設計和更嚴格的監控
blocks.en: Requires a different carbon bed design and tighter monitoring

blocks.zh: 進水若含氯胺，系統設計的複雜度會顯著增加。
blocks.en: If the feedwater contains chloramine, the complexity of the system design increases significantly.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: Q1：為什麼 ISPE 建議進水品質需要「經過一年的驗證週期」？只測試一兩次不行嗎？
blocks.en: Q1: Why does ISPE recommend that feedwater quality go through a "one-year validation cycle"? Is testing once or twice not enough?

blocks.zh: Q2：你的工廠位於農業區，夏季雨後自來水常出現渾濁。這屬於四大污染物中的哪一類？你會增加哪些測試項目？
blocks.en: Q2: Your plant is in an agricultural area, and the tap water often becomes turbid after summer rains. Which of the four contaminant categories does this belong to? What additional tests would you add?

blocks.zh: 前處理產水品質  |  pp. 48–49
blocks.en: Pretreatment Product Water Quality  |  pp. 48-49

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Table 4-1 的決策意涵
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Decision Implications of Table 4-1

blocks.zh: 這張表是整個前處理設計的風險矩陣——它告訴你：如果前處理沒有妥善處理某類雜質，最終處理設備會受到多大影響。
blocks.en: This table is the risk matrix for the whole pretreatment design - it tells you how much the final treatment equipment will be affected if a given class of impurity is not properly handled in pretreatment.

blocks.zh: RO 系統最怕：顆粒物（Fouling）、硬度（Scaling）、氯（膜降解），但不怕氯化物
blocks.en: RO systems are most sensitive to: particulates (fouling), hardness (scaling), and chlorine (membrane degradation), but are not sensitive to chloride

blocks.zh: 蒸餾系統最怕：氯（腐蝕+帶入產品）、氯化物（腐蝕），對顆粒物耐受度較高
blocks.en: Distillation systems are most sensitive to: chlorine (corrosion + carryover into the product) and chloride (corrosion), while being more tolerant of particulates

blocks.zh: 設計前處理時，先確定你的最終處理方式，然後對照這張表，找出最需要優先控制的雜質。
blocks.en: When designing pretreatment, first determine your final treatment method, then check this table to identify the impurities that most need priority control.

blocks.zh: 關鍵指標：SDI（Silt Density Index）
blocks.en: Key indicator: SDI (Silt Density Index)

blocks.zh: SDI（淤泥密度指數）是衡量水中微粒堵塞 RO 膜能力的標準測試方法。
blocks.en: SDI (Silt Density Index) is the standard test method for measuring the ability of particulates in water to plug an RO membrane.

blocks.zh: 測試方法：在固定壓力下（30 psi），量測 0.45 μm 濾膜在特定時間內的通量衰減
blocks.en: Test method: at a fixed pressure (30 psi), measure the flux decline through a 0.45 µm filter membrane over a specified time

blocks.zh: 前處理目標值：SDI 3~5（RO 膜供應商通常要求 SDI < 5）
blocks.en: Pretreatment target: SDI 3-5 (RO membrane suppliers usually require SDI < 5)

blocks.zh: Hardness（硬度）目標：< 1 grain/gallon（約 17 ppm as CaCO<sub>3</sub>）
blocks.en: Hardness target: < 1 grain/gallon (about 17 ppm as CaCO<sub>3</sub>)

blocks.zh: 日常比喻：不同廚具怕不同東西
blocks.en: Everyday analogy: different kitchenware is afraid of different things

blocks.zh: RO 膜像精密的濾布——最怕被硬物刺穿（顆粒堵塞）和化學腐蝕（氯）。蒸餾器像不鏽鋼鍋——最怕水垢結在加熱面（硬度）和鹽分腐蝕金屬（氯化物）。了解你的「廚具」怕什麼，就知道「備料」（前處理）要注意什麼。
blocks.en: An RO membrane is like a fine filter cloth - it is most afraid of being punctured by hard particles (particulate plugging) and of chemical attack (chlorine). A still is like a stainless steel pot - it is most afraid of scale building up on the heating surface (hardness) and of salts corroding the metal (chloride). Once you know what your "kitchenware" is afraid of, you know what to watch for in the "ingredient preparation" (pretreatment).

blocks.zh: 結垢控制：去除濁度與顆粒物  |  p49
blocks.en: Fouling Control: Removing Turbidity and Particulates  |  p49

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Fouling Control（防堵控制）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Fouling Control

blocks.zh: Fouling（堵塞/結垢）是指顆粒物沉積在膜面或設備表面，導致效能下降。控制方法：
blocks.en: Fouling is the deposition of particulates on membrane or equipment surfaces, causing performance to decline. Control methods:

blocks.zh: Clarification（澄清）：包括 Flocculation（絮凝）、Coagulation（混凝）、Sedimentation（沉降）——但因為製藥用的進水已經是飲用水等級，通常不需要這一步
blocks.en: Clarification: including flocculation, coagulation, and sedimentation - but because the feedwater for pharmaceutical use is already drinking-water grade, this step is usually not needed

blocks.zh: Depth/Media Filtration（深層/介質過濾）：最常用的第一步，多層砂過濾器可去除 10 微米以上的顆粒
blocks.en: Depth/media filtration: the most commonly used first step; multimedia sand filters can remove particles larger than 10 microns

blocks.zh: 重點提示：介質過濾器的微生物風險
blocks.en: Key point: the microbial risk of media filters

blocks.zh: 介質過濾器（Media Filter）是微生物滋生的溫床——濾料表面積大、水流緩慢、營養物質被截留。如果進水不含微生物控制劑（如氯），必須定期消毒（熱消毒或化學消毒），否則過濾器反而會成為微生物的「培養皿」。
blocks.en: A media filter is a breeding ground for microorganisms - the media has a large surface area, the water flows slowly, and nutrients are retained. If the feedwater contains no microbial control agent (such as chlorine), the filter must be sanitized regularly (thermal or chemical sanitization); otherwise the filter becomes a "petri dish" for microorganisms.

blocks.zh: 這是一個非常重要的設計考量：防止顆粒物堵塞的同時，不能忽略微生物控制。
blocks.en: This is a very important design consideration: while preventing particulate fouling, you cannot neglect microbial control.

blocks.zh: Q：你的前處理系統中，介質過濾器位於活性碳床之後（氯已被去除）。這種配置可能帶來什麼風險？你會如何處理？
blocks.en: Q: In your pretreatment system, the media filter is located after the activated carbon bed (where the chlorine has already been removed). What risks could this configuration bring? How would you address them?

blocks.zh: 水垢控制：去除硬度與金屬  |  pp. 49–51
blocks.en: Scaling Control: Removing Hardness and Metals  |  pp. 49-51

blocks.zh: 日常比喻：水垢就像水壺裡的白色沉澱
blocks.en: Everyday analogy: scale is like the white deposit in a kettle

blocks.zh: 家裡燒開水常看到壺底白色結垢——那就是 Calcium Carbonate（碳酸鈣）。在工業水系統中，這些沉澱物會堵塞 RO 膜或覆蓋蒸餾器加熱面，嚴重影響效能。軟化器的作用就像「水質柔順劑」，把導致結垢的鈣鎂離子換成不會結垢的鈉離子。
blocks.en: At home, boiling water often leaves white scale on the bottom of the kettle - that is calcium carbonate. In an industrial water system, these deposits can plug RO membranes or coat the heating surfaces of stills, seriously affecting performance. A softener acts like a "water conditioner", exchanging the scale-forming calcium and magnesium ions for sodium ions that do not form scale.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：設備位置決定微生物風險
blocks.en: Key point: equipment position determines microbial risk

blocks.zh: 前處理系統中，每個設備的相對位置都會影響微生物控制策略。在微生物控制劑（如氯）被移除之後的所有設備，都需要額外的微生物控制措施（定期消毒、UV 處理等）。這是前處理設計中最需要系統性思考的部分。
blocks.en: In a pretreatment system, the relative position of each piece of equipment affects the microbial control strategy. All equipment downstream of the point where the microbial control agent (such as chlorine) is removed needs additional microbial control measures (periodic sanitization, UV treatment, and so on). This is the part of pretreatment design that most requires systematic thinking.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：軟化器位置的兩難選擇
blocks.en: Core Concept: The softener-position dilemma

blocks.zh: 大多數情況下，將軟化器放在「氯去除前」是較佳選擇——犧牲一點點樹脂壽命，換來持續的微生物保護，整體成本更低。
blocks.en: In most cases, placing the softener "before chlorine removal" is the better choice - you sacrifice a little resin life in exchange for continuous microbial protection, and the overall cost is lower.

blocks.zh: 有機物去除  |  pp. 50–51
blocks.en: Organics Removal  |  pp. 50-51

blocks.zh: 重點提示：活性碳的雙面刃
blocks.en: Key point: activated carbon is a double-edged sword

blocks.zh: Activated Carbon（活性碳）是前處理中最常用的「多功能選手」：去除有機物 + 去除氯/氯胺。但它最大的問題是自身就是微生物的理想培養基——巨大的表面積、被吸附的有機物成為營養源。
blocks.en: Activated carbon is the most commonly used "multi-purpose performer" in pretreatment: it removes organics and removes chlorine/chloramine. But its biggest problem is that it is itself an ideal growth medium for microorganisms - the huge surface area and the adsorbed organics become a nutrient source.

blocks.zh: 因此，活性碳床必須配合：
blocks.en: Activated carbon beds must therefore be supported by:

blocks.zh: 定期熱消毒或化學消毒
blocks.en: Periodic thermal or chemical sanitization

blocks.zh: 嚴格的微生物監控
blocks.en: Rigorous microbial monitoring

blocks.zh: 合理的更換/再生週期
blocks.en: A reasonable replacement/regeneration cycle

blocks.zh: 日常比喻：活性碳像冰箱的除臭劑
blocks.en: Everyday analogy: activated carbon is like a refrigerator deodorizer

blocks.zh: 活性碳就像冰箱裡的竹炭除臭包——它能吸附異味（有機物），但用久了之後，除臭包本身也會發霉（微生物生長）。定期更換或消毒是必要的。
blocks.en: Activated carbon is like a bamboo charcoal deodorizer pack in the refrigerator - it adsorbs odors (organics), but after long use the pack itself goes moldy (microbial growth). Regular replacement or sanitization is necessary.

blocks.zh: 微生物生長控制  |  pp. 51–52
blocks.en: Microbial Growth Control  |  pp. 51-52

blocks.zh: 核心概念：微生物控制的四層防線
blocks.en: Core Concept: Four layers of defense in microbial control

blocks.zh: Microbial Control Agent（微生物控制劑）：氯或氯胺，來自市政水處理，盡量保留到前處理後段
blocks.en: Microbial control agent: chlorine or chloramine, which comes from municipal water treatment and should be retained as far into the pretreatment train as possible

blocks.zh: Periodic Sanitization（定期消毒）：控制劑移除後的主要手段，可用熱水（>80°C）或化學消毒劑
blocks.en: Periodic sanitization: the main means after the control agent is removed, using hot water (>80°C) or chemical sanitizers

blocks.zh: UV Light（紫外線）：即時抑制微生物，常設在 RO 進水前
blocks.en: UV light: provides immediate suppression of microorganisms, often installed ahead of the RO feed

blocks.zh: Design Practices（設計實務）：避免 Dead Legs（死水區）和水滯留
blocks.en: Design practices: avoid dead legs and water stagnation

blocks.zh: 重點提示：氯的「保護傘」策略
blocks.en: Key point: the chlorine "umbrella" strategy

blocks.zh: ISPE 的建議非常明確：盡量讓市政水中的氯保留到前處理的最後階段。這意味著：
blocks.en: ISPE's recommendation is very clear: keep the chlorine in the municipal water for as long as possible, until the last stage of pretreatment. This means:

blocks.zh: 活性碳床（去除氯的位置）應盡量放在前處理的後段
blocks.en: The activated carbon bed (where chlorine is removed) should be placed as late as possible in the pretreatment train

blocks.zh: 活性碳床之前的設備（如軟化器、介質過濾器）都受到氯的保護
blocks.en: Equipment ahead of the activated carbon bed (such as softeners and media filters) is protected by the chlorine

blocks.zh: 活性碳床之後的設備必須有獨立的微生物控制措施
blocks.en: Equipment after the activated carbon bed must have independent microbial control measures

blocks.zh: 這個「保護傘」概念是前處理系統設計的核心哲學之一。
blocks.en: This "umbrella" concept is one of the core philosophies of pretreatment system design.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：UV 的正確使用位置
blocks.en: Practical application: the correct placement of UV

blocks.zh: UV 只在光照存在時有效——它不像氯有「殘餘保護力」。因此 UV 的最佳使用位置是：
blocks.en: UV is effective only while light is present - unlike chlorine, it has no "residual protection". The best places to use UV are therefore:

blocks.zh: RO 進水前：降低微生物計數，保護 RO 膜
blocks.en: Before the RO feed: reduces microbial counts and protects the RO membrane

blocks.zh: 儲存槽前：防止微生物進入儲存階段
blocks.en: Before storage tanks: prevents microorganisms from entering the storage stage

blocks.zh: 關鍵過濾器前：保護過濾器不成為微生物培養基
blocks.en: Before critical filters: protects filters from becoming a microbial growth medium

blocks.zh: UV 是「點防禦」而非「區域防禦」——不能取代系統性的消毒策略。
blocks.en: UV is a "point defense" rather than an "area defense" - it cannot replace a systematic sanitization strategy.

blocks.zh: 微生物控制劑的去除  |  pp. 52–53
blocks.en: Removal of Microbial Control Agents  |  pp. 52-53

blocks.zh: 重點提示：Ammonia 是氯胺系統的最大挑戰
blocks.en: Key point: ammonia is the biggest challenge in chloramine systems

blocks.zh: Ammonia（氨）是氯胺分解後的產物，也是製藥水系統中最難處理的物質之一：
blocks.en: Ammonia is a decomposition product of chloramine and one of the most difficult substances to handle in pharmaceutical water systems:

blocks.zh: 氨在鹼性條件下為分子態（NH<sub>3</sub>），可穿透 RO 膜和蒸餾系統
blocks.en: Under alkaline conditions, ammonia is in its molecular form (NH<sub>3</sub>), which can pass through RO membranes and distillation systems

blocks.zh: 氨在酸性條件下為離子態（NH<sub>4</sub><sup>+</sup>），可被 RO 去除
blocks.en: Under acidic conditions, ammonia is in its ionic form (NH<sub>4</sub><sup>+</sup>), which can be removed by RO

blocks.zh: 但在蒸餾的高溫環境中，Ammonium 會部分轉化為 Ammonia，導致 Carryover（帶出）
blocks.en: But at the high temperatures of distillation, ammonium is partly converted back to ammonia, causing carryover

blocks.zh: 如果你的進水含氯胺，系統設計必須額外考慮氨的控制策略。
blocks.en: If your feedwater contains chloramine, the system design must give additional consideration to an ammonia control strategy.

blocks.zh: Q1：你的工廠所在城市剛從 Chlorine 消毒改為 Chloramine 消毒。你的前處理系統需要做哪些調整？
blocks.en: Q1: The city where your plant is located has just switched from chlorine to chloramine disinfection. What adjustments does your pretreatment system need?

blocks.zh: Q2：為什麼含氯胺的進水搭配蒸餾（Distillation）作為最終處理時，比搭配 RO 更具挑戰性？
blocks.en: Q2: Why is chloramine-containing feedwater more challenging when distillation is the final treatment than when RO is?

blocks.zh: 陰離子組成變化  |  pp. 52–53
blocks.en: Changes in Anion Composition  |  pp. 52-53

blocks.zh: 核心概念：前處理如何改變陰離子組成
blocks.en: Core Concept: How pretreatment changes anion composition

blocks.zh: 前處理主要針對非離子性雜質和陽離子（如 Ca2+、Mg2+），但某些前處理步驟會間接改變陰離子組成：
blocks.en: Pretreatment mainly targets non-ionic impurities and cations (such as Ca2+ and Mg2+), but some pretreatment steps indirectly change the anion composition:

blocks.zh: 酸化 + 脫氣：碳酸鹽/碳酸氫鹽 → 硫酸鹽（因為加的是硫酸）
blocks.en: Acidification + degasification: carbonate/bicarbonate → sulfate (because sulfuric acid is what is added)

blocks.zh: 碳床去氯：氯 → 氯離子（Cl-）
blocks.en: Dechlorination by carbon bed: chlorine → chloride ion (Cl-)

blocks.zh: 亞硫酸鈉還原：亞硫酸鈉 → 硫酸鹽（SO42-），氯 → 氯離子
blocks.en: Sodium bisulfite reduction: sodium bisulfite → sulfate (SO42-), chlorine → chloride ion

blocks.zh: 這些陰離子的變化通常在最終處理（RO 或離子交換）中被去除，但設計師需要了解這些變化以進行正確的物料平衡計算。
blocks.en: These anion changes are usually removed in final treatment (RO or ion exchange), but designers need to understand them in order to perform correct material balance calculations.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：氯離子對蒸餾系統的威脅
blocks.en: Key point: the threat of chloride to distillation systems

blocks.zh: 如果最終處理使用蒸餾，前處理中產生的氯離子（Chloride）是一個重要考量。氯離子在蒸餾的高溫環境下會造成不鏽鋼的點蝕（Pitting Corrosion）和應力腐蝕裂紋（Stress Corrosion Cracking）。這時候可能需要在蒸餾前加一道 RO 來降低氯離子濃度。
blocks.en: If the final treatment is distillation, the chloride produced in pretreatment is an important consideration. At the high temperatures of distillation, chloride causes pitting corrosion and stress corrosion cracking of stainless steel. An RO step may then be needed ahead of the still to reduce the chloride concentration.

blocks.zh: pH 在前處理中的重要性  |  pp. 53–54
blocks.en: The Importance of pH in Pretreatment  |  pp. 53-54

blocks.zh: 化學平衡：CO<sub>2</sub> / NH<sub>3</sub> 的 pH 依賴性
blocks.en: Chemical Equilibrium: pH Dependence of CO<sub>2</sub> / NH<sub>3</sub>

blocks.zh: 日常比喻：pH 就像溫度調節
blocks.en: Everyday analogy: pH is like temperature control

blocks.zh: 想像你需要同時保存巧克力（需冷藏）和麵包（需室溫）——不能用同一個溫度滿足兩者。CO<sub>2</sub> 和 NH<sub>3</sub> 就是這樣：它們在 pH「溫度」上的最佳去除條件互相矛盾，所以需要分兩步處理。
blocks.en: Imagine you need to store chocolate (which needs refrigeration) and bread (which needs room temperature) at the same time - one temperature cannot satisfy both. CO<sub>2</sub> and NH<sub>3</sub> are like this: their optimal removal conditions on the pH "thermometer" conflict with each other, so they must be handled in two steps.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：pH 如何影響 CO<sub>2</sub> 和 NH<sub>3</sub> 的存在形態
blocks.en: Core Concept: How pH affects the forms of CO<sub>2</sub> and NH<sub>3</sub>

blocks.zh: pH 決定了水中 Carbon Dioxide（二氧化碳）和 Ammonia（氨）的化學形態：
blocks.en: pH determines the chemical form of carbon dioxide and ammonia in water:

blocks.zh: 問題在於：沒有一個 pH 值能同時讓 CO2 和 NH3 都變成可被輕鬆去除的形態。如果兩者同時存在，必須分兩步進行 pH 調整和去除。
blocks.en: The problem is: no single pH value turns both CO2 and NH3 into forms that are easy to remove. If both are present, pH adjustment and removal must be carried out in two steps.

blocks.zh: 建造材質與施工實務  |  pp. 53–54
blocks.en: Materials of Construction and Installation Practices  |  pp. 53-54

blocks.zh: 重點提示：前處理不需要「過度設計」
blocks.en: Key point: pretreatment does not need to be "over-designed"

blocks.zh: ISPE 在這裡明確指出：前處理系統不需要分配系統等級的施工規格：
blocks.en: ISPE states clearly here that pretreatment systems do not need distribution-system-grade construction specifications:

blocks.zh: 不需要 Electropolishing（電拋光）——Mill Finish（研磨面）即可
blocks.en: Electropolishing is not required - a mill finish is sufficient

blocks.zh: 不需要 Orbital Welding（自動軌道焊接）——一般焊接或法蘭連接即可
blocks.en: Orbital welding is not required - conventional welding or flanged connections are sufficient

blocks.zh: 不需要 Sanitary Fittings（衛生級接頭）——壓縮接頭或溶劑接合即可
blocks.en: Sanitary fittings are not required - compression fittings or solvent-bonded joints are sufficient

blocks.zh: 這是重要的成本優化機會。許多工廠錯誤地在前處理系統使用與分配系統相同的高規格材質和施工方式，造成不必要的成本增加。
blocks.en: This is an important cost-optimization opportunity. Many plants mistakenly use the same high-specification materials and construction methods in the pretreatment system as in the distribution system, creating unnecessary cost.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：Good Engineering Practice 的具體體現
blocks.en: Practical application: a concrete expression of Good Engineering Practice

blocks.zh: 正確的做法是根據每個區段的實際需求選擇材質：
blocks.en: The correct approach is to select materials according to the actual needs of each section:

blocks.zh: 進水管路到軟化器：PVC 管路 + 溶劑接合（成本最低）
blocks.en: Feed piping to the softener: PVC piping + solvent-bonded joints (lowest cost)

blocks.zh: 活性碳床到 RO 之間：如果需要熱消毒，改用 PVDF 或 SS
blocks.en: Between the activated carbon bed and the RO: if thermal sanitization is required, use PVDF or stainless steel instead

blocks.zh: 每個設備上下游：設置取樣點和壓力/溫度量測點（用於監控與故障排除）
blocks.en: Upstream and downstream of each piece of equipment: provide sampling points and pressure/temperature measurement points (for monitoring and troubleshooting)

blocks.zh: 原則：選擇不會劣化水質的最低成本材質。
blocks.en: Principle: select the lowest-cost material that does not degrade the water quality.

blocks.zh: 前處理總結  |  pp. 54–55
blocks.en: Pretreatment Summary  |  pp. 54-55

blocks.zh: 核心概念：前處理的四大任務總結
blocks.en: Core Concept: Summary of the four tasks of pretreatment

blocks.zh: 去除 Turbidity / Particulates（濁度/顆粒物）→ 防止 Fouling（堵塞）
blocks.en: Remove turbidity / particulates → prevent fouling

blocks.zh: 去除 Hardness / Metals（硬度/金屬）→ 防止 Scaling（結垢）
blocks.en: Remove hardness / metals → prevent scaling

blocks.zh: 去除 Organics / Microbiological Impurities（有機物/微生物）→ 維護水質
blocks.en: Remove organics / microbiological impurities → maintain water quality

blocks.zh: 控制 Microbial Growth + 去除 Microbial Control Agents（微生物控制）→ 保護最終處理設備
blocks.en: Control microbial growth + remove microbial control agents → protect the final treatment equipment

blocks.zh: 前處理的效果分為兩類：
blocks.en: The effects of pretreatment fall into two categories:

blocks.zh: 直接效果：即時影響最終產水品質
blocks.en: Direct effects: immediately affect final product water quality

blocks.zh: 間接效果：長期影響最終處理設備的效能和壽命
blocks.en: Indirect effects: affect the performance and life of the final treatment equipment over the long term

blocks.zh: 重點提示：GEP 與驗證要求
blocks.en: Key point: GEP and validation requirements

blocks.zh: 前處理系統需遵循 Good Engineering Practices（良好工程實務），而非 GMP 等級的嚴格要求。但前處理的驗證（Validation）是整個水系統驗證的一部分，必須包含微生物監控。
blocks.en: Pretreatment systems follow Good Engineering Practice (GEP) rather than GMP-level requirements. However, validation of the pretreatment is part of the validation of the whole water system and must include microbial monitoring.

blocks.zh: 這代表：前處理設計可以用較低成本的材質和施工方式，但其效能驗證和持續監控不能馬虎。
blocks.en: This means that pretreatment can be designed with lower-cost materials and construction methods, but its performance validation and ongoing monitoring must not be neglected.

blocks.zh: 本章摘要 Chapter 4 Summary
blocks.en: Chapter 4 Summary

blocks.zh: 前處理定位：Pretreatment 是最終處理前的所有製程步驟，目的是將進水品質調整到最終處理設備可接受的水準。前處理的穩定性直接決定最終處理的運作可靠度和維護成本。
blocks.en: Role of pretreatment: Pretreatment comprises all process steps before final treatment, and its purpose is to bring feedwater quality up to a level the final treatment equipment can accept. The stability of pretreatment directly determines the operating reliability and maintenance cost of final treatment.

blocks.zh: 進水品質：製藥水系統必須使用符合 Drinking Water 標準的進水。進水品質需經過至少一年的監控，掌握季節性變異。四大污染物類型：Particulates、Inorganics、Organics、Bacteria。
blocks.en: Feedwater quality: Pharmaceutical water systems must use feedwater that meets drinking water standards. Feedwater quality must be monitored for at least one year to capture seasonal variation. The four contaminant types are particulates, inorganics, organics, and bacteria.

blocks.zh: 四大前處理任務：(1) Fouling 控制——介質過濾去除顆粒物；(2) Scaling 控制——軟化器去除硬度；(3) Organics 去除——活性碳吸附；(4) 微生物控制——保留氯的「保護傘」+ 定期消毒 + UV。
blocks.en: Four pretreatment tasks: (1) Fouling control - media filtration removes particulates; (2) Scaling control - softeners remove hardness; (3) Organics removal - activated carbon adsorption; (4) Microbial control - the chlorine "umbrella" + periodic sanitization + UV.

blocks.zh: Chlorine vs Chloramine：氯胺的去除比氯更複雜，副產物 Ammonia 會穿透 RO 和蒸餾系統。進水含氯胺時，系統設計複雜度顯著增加。
blocks.en: Chlorine vs chloramine: Chloramine is more complex to remove than chlorine, and its by-product ammonia can pass through RO and distillation systems. When the feedwater contains chloramine, system design complexity increases significantly.

blocks.zh: pH 的關鍵角色：pH 決定 CO2 和 NH3 的化學形態，影響去除策略。兩者無法在同一 pH 下同時被最佳去除，需分步處理。
blocks.en: The key role of pH: pH determines the chemical forms of CO2 and NH3 and affects the removal strategy. The two cannot both be optimally removed at the same pH, so they must be handled in separate steps.

blocks.zh: 材質與成本：前處理不需要分配系統等級的材質和施工規格。Electropolishing、Orbital Welding、Sanitary Fittings 在前處理中通常不必要。選擇「不劣化水質的最低成本材質」是重要的成本優化策略。
blocks.en: Materials and cost: Pretreatment does not need distribution-system-grade materials and construction specifications. Electropolishing, orbital welding, and sanitary fittings are generally unnecessary in pretreatment. Selecting "the lowest-cost material that does not degrade water quality" is an important cost-optimization strategy.

blocks.zh: 驗證要求：前處理遵循 GEP（非 GMP），但作為水系統一部分，其驗證（含微生物監控）是必要的。
blocks.en: Validation requirements: Pretreatment follows GEP (not GMP), but as part of the water system, its validation (including microbial monitoring) is required.
